name: Ero Copper Corp.
description: Ero Copper is a Vancouver-based copper producer with all operations in Brazil, including the Caraíba Operations in Bahia State and the Tucumã Operation in Pará State, as well as the Xavantina gold mine in Mato Grosso State. The company is a clean copper producer, reporting Q1 2026 consolidated copper production of 17,287 tonnes from its two copper mines.
